thread:
Maya R: heads-up: after the midnight keystore policy rollout a lot of prod-ml boot pods are failing with 403s fetching node tokens. GPUs not joining warm pools.
Raj: confirmed in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. started ~00:02 UTC. autoscaler keeps spinning -> cost alert.
Ivy: sample log from init:
```
2026-08-12T00:02:11Z init: vault read 403 path=secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token
policy="keystore-region-tight-2026-08-12"
```
Tom (security): we narrowed access to region-specific paths to reduce blast radius. looks like older bootstrap agents still request the legacy path. missed adding the agent SA to the new mapping.
Maya R: impact: nodes can't decrypt model shards, kube join fails, warm pool drops. ops-bot posted cost spike at 00:20.
ops-bot: Cost alert: GPU spend +110% vs baseline (us-west-2).
Ivy: short-term fix: mint a short-lived fallback token scoped to the legacy path and inject into infra bootstrap secret. Low blast radius.
Tom (security): I can approve emergency exception for 30m TTL if scoped to agent SA. also re-enable audit exporter now; it was paused during rollout.
Nina (compliance): pause note: we need to record the audit gap and affected node IDs for regulator reporting.
Raj: Benched commands (dry-run then apply):
```
vault policy write tmp-legacy-allow - <<EOF
path "secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF
vault token create -policy=tmp-legacy-allow -orphan -ttl=30m
kubectl -n infra create secret generic fallback-bootstrap-token --from-literal=token=<token>
```
Maya R: token created and secret injected. nodes are starting to pull and join; warm pools recovering. cost alert downgraded at 00:46.
Tom (security): follow-ups: (1) add agent SA mapping to the rollout matrix, (2) add a canary that boots one node and validates keystore access before global rollout, (3) make audit toggles two-person approval. I'll file PRs.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0812-KEYSTOREFALLBACK created, linked to PLT-8310.
Maya R: creating the follow-up ticket and assigning owners. closing when warm pools stable.
